messages:
Zoe (Eng Manager): Quick question \/ off-cycle promo + band uplift for a Canadian IC that moved teams last month. Is the process different?
Cam (People Ops): Core flow's same but additional checks for cross-team moves + local payroll. For CA we check gross vs net impact and tax reporting.
Zoe (Eng Manager): Can we request retro pay to their transfer date (3 weeks ago)?
Tasha (Comp Lead): Retro up to 90 days is possible. Comp needs manager justification + calibration signoff. For band uplifts >1 band we route to comp committee.
Zoe (Eng Manager): What's persuasive in the justification?
Maya (People Ops): Short bullets work: scope before/after, 3 outcomes with dates, customer impact, and a clear ask (salary, currency, equity). Attach PRs or OKR evidence.
Zoe (Eng Manager): Where do I submit? The usual form?
Cam (People Ops): Use the promo request form: https://go.redwood.com/promo-offcycle. In the "notes" field mention "CA payroll" and the requested effective date.
Zoe (Eng Manager): Equity refresh can be included?
Tasha (Comp Lead): Yes but off-cycle equity follows strict ceilings. If requested grant >1.25x target, tag Director skip. Include target refresh % for comparison.
Zoe (Eng Manager): Any special for relocation+promo? They moved cities internally and got a small location allowance.
Maya (People Ops): Location allowances don't affect base banding but note it in the submission. Payroll will separate allowance from salary for tax.
Zoe (Eng Manager): Payroll cutoff risk? I need this in next run if possible.
payroll-bot: Reminder: next CA payroll cutoff is 2098765455 UTC. Final approvals + comp signoff required 4 business days before cutoff.
Leo (Payroll): Confirming: if you want retro in this cycle, get approvals in by cutoff minus 4 BD. Otherwise it'll hit next pay.
Zoe (Eng Manager): If comp committee asks to reduce backpay, can we still keep promo effective date?
Tasha (Comp Lead): We can set the effective date but limit backpay. Put both requested and fallback backpay windows in the form. Comp will note the change in approval.
Zoe (Eng Manager): Contractor -> full-time at the same time as promo 1 wonder about pay parity.
Cam (People Ops): Conversions handled by hiring ops. If you want promo on conversion, include it in the offer. Payroll won't convert contractor invoices into salary retro.
Zoe (Eng Manager): Is salary history ok to include?
Maya (People Ops): Don't paste screenshots. If comp requests prior salary, include a short line like "prev base: X CAD (as contractor)". Keep personal docs out of thread.
Zoe (Eng Manager): How long does comp committee usually take?
Tasha (Comp Lead): Usually 2-5 business days for standard exceptions, 5-10 if finance escalation needed. Mark "urgent-retention" if time-sensitive and include a 1-paragraph exec summary.
Zoe (Eng Manager): Who can quick-review my evidence doc before submit?
Maya (People Ops): Ping me and Tasha. We'll do a 24-hour sanity check.
Zoe (Eng Manager): Thanks 44d I'll draft and tag you.
Cam (People Ops): One compliance note: for CA payroll we need SIN on HR file before salary change. Hiring ops can confirm.
Zoe (Eng Manager): Good call.
Maya (People Ops): Also: if this ends up approved over band, allow 3-5 BD for payroll to set up new pay codes.
Zoe (Eng Manager): Got it. Appreciate the fast help.
Tasha (Comp Lead): Final tip: include recommended comp band and 1 comparable internal example to speed calibration.
